text: 4 CONTRAINDICATIONS LEQVIO IS CONTRAINDICATED IN PATIENTS WITH A PRIOR SERIOUS HYPERSENSITIVITY REACTION TO INCLISIRAN OR ANY OF THE EXCIPIENTS IN LEQVIO.
